headline: Uzbekistan and World Bank hold talks to expand agricultural sector investments
summary: Government representatives from Uzbekistan met with World Bank officials to discuss expanding investment cooperation targeting the modernization of the domestic livestock sector.
why: World Bank development financing supports structural agricultural modernization and supply chain infrastructure across Central Asian economies.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Expanded World Bank investment cooperation enhances modernization in the livestock sector.
